info.title: CSGHub Lite Local API
info.description:
Structured documentation for the local `/api/*` and `/v1/*` endpoints served by `csghub-lite`.

Request correlation: every API response includes `X-Request-ID` and `X-B3-TraceId`. Callers may provide `X-Request-ID` using up to 128 alphanumeric or `-_.:` characters and may provide a non-zero 16- or 32-hex-character `X-B3-TraceId`; invalid values are replaced. Text-generation requests also accept `X-CSGLite-Trace-ID` and `X-CSGLite-Thread-ID`. A valid CSGLite trace ID remains the logical Observability grouping key, while B3 identifies the distributed path through trusted inference services.

Maintenance note: whenever you add, remove, or rename an `/api/*` or `/v1/*` route in `internal/server/routes.go`, update this file and run the OpenAPI sync test before merging.

get.description: Returns local, CSGHub cloud, and selected third-party provider models. Each model preserves its configured provider display name while `source` carries its stable routing identity. Use `provider` to filter by a stable provider ID or configured provider name. Provider filters return selected models configured through `/api/tags/manage`; when no `csghub` cloud selection has been saved, all cloud catalog models are returned.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Force a refresh of the cloud model catalog before returning results.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Filter models case-insensitively by provider alias. Local models accept `local`; cloud models accept `csghub` or the configured cloud provider name; third-party models accept their stable provider ID or configured provider name.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional csghub-lite category key from `/api/pipeline-tags`. When provided, only models whose pipeline tag belongs to the category are returned.

patch.description: Updates metadata for a selected provider model and can change the client-visible model ID. The built-in `csghub` cloud provider also supports this endpoint; patching a default cloud catalog model creates a selection automatically. The original upstream model ID is preserved internally for inference calls. Use an empty string to clear an overridden display name or description.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider ID or configured provider name. Use `csghub` for the built-in cloud provider.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Current client-visible provider model ID to update. Required when changing the model ID; the request body `model` value is the new client-visible ID.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider ID or configured provider name. Use `csghub` for the built-in cloud provider.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Provider model ID to remove from the selected list.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search text matched against model metadata.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Filter by local model format, such as `gguf`.

parameters.name: pipeline_tag
parameters.description: Filter by detected pipeline type, such as `text-generation` or `image-text-to-text`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to `20`, capped at `100`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based offset into the filtered result set.

get.summary: Get a local model download manifest by public model ID
get.description: Resolves a local model by its public inference ID, such as a short model name shown in the local model library, and returns its download manifest.

parameters.name: artifact_source

post.description: Imports a local model from multipart form data. Use `mode=archive` for a single `.zip`, `.tar`, `.tar.gz`, or `.tgz` file; use `mode=files` or `mode=directory` with one or more files and matching `paths` values.

model.description: Optional target model ID in `namespace/name` form. Defaults to `local/<filename>` when omitted.

paths.description: Relative paths corresponding to uploaded files. Folder uploads should provide browser-relative paths.

post.summary: Start a local model upload session
post.description: Creates a resumable-style upload session used by the web UI for large model files. Files are uploaded one at a time with raw PUT requests, then imported on complete.

put.summary: Upload a file to a model upload session
put.description: Uploads a model file as raw bytes. For large files, send sequential chunks with `Content-Range: bytes start-end/total`; the server validates and returns the next accepted offset. Omitting `Content-Range` preserves whole-file PUT compatibility.

parameters.name: Content-Range
parameters.description: Byte range for this chunk, for example `bytes 0-33554431/1073741824`.

409.description: The supplied chunk offset does not match the stored file offset.

CorrelationRequestID.name: X-Request-ID
CorrelationRequestID.description: End-to-end request correlation ID. Invalid or missing values are replaced and the effective value is returned in the response.

B3TraceID.name: X-B3-TraceId
B3TraceID.description: B3-compatible distributed trace ID propagated to trusted inference services. Must be a non-zero 16- or 32-character hexadecimal value.

ROMAHost.name: Host
ROMAHost.description: ROMA API group domain. When ROMA credentials are also present and the request uses a remote model, this authority is forwarded to the selected OpenAI-compatible upstream.

ROMAHWID.name: X-HW-ID
ROMAHWID.description: ROMA integration application Key. Forwarded to the selected OpenAI-compatible upstream when present.

ROMAHWAppKey.name: X-HW-AppKey
ROMAHWAppKey.description: ROMA integration application Secret. Forwarded to the selected OpenAI-compatible upstream when present.

name.description: Header name. Host is supported as the request authority. X-Model is reserved for one local model ID, skips provider model discovery, and is not forwarded upstream.

value.description: Header value, or the local model ID when name is X-Model.

api_key.description: Configured provider API key. Returned by the third_party provider list; omitted from create and update responses.

headers.description: Optional headers automatically added to requests sent to this provider.

source.description: Provider source, such as local, cloud, or provider.

api_key.description: Optional Bearer token. Leave blank when the provider authenticates through custom headers or requires no authentication.

id.description: Existing provider ID. When supplied, a blank API key reuses the saved key for validation.

probe.description: When true and X-Model is configured, send a non-streaming chat completion with max_tokens=1 to verify the model, authentication, and custom headers.

model.description: Concrete model ID for this member.
Public model ID exposed by the pool.
Provider catalog model ID to select. This becomes the initial client-visible model ID and is retained internally as the original upstream model ID.

display_name.description: Optional custom display name shown in model lists. When omitted, the provider default name is used.

description.description: Optional custom model description shown in model metadata. When omitted, the provider default description is used.

model.description: New client-visible model ID. When the `model` query parameter is omitted, this value is used only to locate the existing model for metadata-only legacy requests.

display_name.description: Custom display name. Send an empty string to clear the override.

description.description: Custom model description. Send an empty string to clear the override.

cloud_provider_name.description: Provider name shown for built-in cloud models.

huggingface_token_configured.description: Whether a persisted Hugging Face access token is configured. The token itself is never returned.

modelscope_token_configured.description: Whether a persisted ModelScope access token is configured. The token itself is never returned.

marketplace_model_source.description: Persisted model registry selected by the Marketplace UI.

marketplace_dataset_source.description: Persisted dataset registry selected by the Marketplace UI.

hidden_nav_items.description: Stable IDs of left navigation items hidden by the runtime environment configuration.

server_url.description: CSGHub marketplace server URL. Empty string restores the default server URL.

ai_gateway_url.description: OpenCSG AI Gateway URL. Empty string clears the custom value and uses the default AI Gateway.

cloud_provider_name.description: Provider name shown for built-in cloud models. Empty string restores the default provider name.

huggingface_endpoint.description: Hugging Face Hub endpoint. Empty string restores the default endpoint.

huggingface_token.description: Hugging Face access token. Empty string clears the persisted token.

modelscope_endpoint.description: ModelScope Hub endpoint. Empty string restores the default endpoint.

modelscope_token.description: ModelScope access token. Empty string clears the persisted token.

marketplace_model_source.description: Model registry to restore when the Marketplace UI opens.

marketplace_dataset_source.description: Dataset registry to restore when the Marketplace UI opens.

retention_days.description: Days to retain observability records. Zero retains records indefinitely.

local_tokens.description: Total tokens consumed by local models.

cloud_tokens.description: Total tokens consumed by non-local models, including OpenCSG cloud and third-party providers.

pool_requests.description: Successful requests routed through a provider pool.

fallback_count.description: Pool member fallbacks before successful responses.

limited_count.description: Pool member attempts skipped or rejected by a configured or upstream rate limit.

total_history.description: Historical total tokens for the selected provider filter, independent of the selected period.

request_id.description: Effective X-Request-ID used for end-to-end request correlation.

b3_trace_id.description: Effective X-B3-TraceId propagated through trusted inference services.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Input tokens served from a provider prompt cache.

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Input tokens written to a provider prompt cache.

cache_eligible_input_tokens.description: Input token denominator used to calculate cache hit rate.

cache_hit_rate.description: Percentage of cache-eligible input tokens served from cache.

DatasetExportTraceFilter.description: Selects every trace matching these server-side conditions across all result pages. Time bounds apply to trace start time.

DatasetPublishRequest.description: Publishes into the authenticated CSGHub user's username namespace.

providers.description: Optional provider order. Empty means automatic order.

model.description: Model ID to run. Local models accept the short public ID returned by model list APIs; legacy `namespace/name` IDs are also accepted.
Model ID returned by the request.
Model ID to run. Local models accept the short public ID returned by model list APIs; legacy `namespace/name` IDs are also accepted.

source.description: Optional source hint. Use `cloud` to force an OpenCSG-backed chat model.

model.description: Model ID returned by the request.

artifact_source.description: Model artifact registry. Empty preserves the historical OpenCSG behavior.

revision.description: Branch, tag, or commit. Empty selects the registry default.

quant.description: GGUF quantization when multiple weight variants exist (e.g. Q4_K_M). Ignored for non-GGUF models.

quants.description: GGUF quantizations to download when multiple weight variants exist. Takes precedence over quant.

total_bytes.description: Total bytes across all files selected for this model download.

completed_bytes.description: Downloaded bytes across all files selected for this model download.

model.description: Model ID to delete. Local models accept the short public ID returned by model list APIs; legacy `namespace/name` IDs are also accepted.
Model ID to inspect. Local models accept the short public ID returned by model list APIs; legacy `namespace/name` IDs are also accepted.
Model ID to stop. Local models accept the short public ID returned by model list APIs; legacy `namespace/name` IDs are also accepted.

draft_model.description: Local GGUF model ID used as the speculative draft model. Optional for draft-mtp when the target includes or ships an MTP companion.

model.description: Model ID to load. Local models accept the short public ID returned by model list APIs; legacy `namespace/name` IDs are also accepted.

name.description: Client-visible model ID. Local models use a short public ID without `namespace/`; when local names collide, later models receive a stable hash suffix.

model.description: Client-visible model ID. Local models use a short public ID without `namespace/`; when local names collide, later models receive a stable hash suffix.

origin.description: Local model origin. `upload` means imported by the user; `marketplace` means downloaded from the marketplace.

provider.description: Provider display name. Local models use `local`; cloud and third-party models preserve the provider name from configuration. Use `source` for stable routing; the `/api/tags` provider filter remains case-insensitive and accepts provider aliases.

artifact_source.description: Registry from which this local model artifact was downloaded.

requested_revision.description: Branch, tag, or commit requested by the user.

resolved_revision.description: Immutable commit when supplied by the registry, otherwise the resolved branch or tag.

category.description: csghub-lite category derived from the model pipeline tag.

input_modalities.description: Input modalities supported by the model, such as text, image, video, audio, or file.

output_modalities.description: Output modalities produced by the model, such as text, image, video, audio, speech, or transcription.

max_model_len.description: Native maximum model context length. Local GGUF models read this from the GGUF metadata header; local SafeTensors models read `config.json.max_position_embeddings`, or `config.json.text_config.max_position_embeddings` for nested text configurations.

step.description: Current load/conversion step for models in the loading state (e.g. installing PyTorch, converting to GGUF).

next_offset.description: Next byte offset the client should upload.

complete.description: Whether the complete file has been received.

revision.description: Requested provider branch, tag, or commit.

origin.description: Local dataset origin. `upload` means imported by the user, `marketplace` means downloaded from the marketplace, and `export` means generated from local observability traces.

repository.description: Provider repository ID without the source prefix.

has_more.description: Whether there are more results available

has_api_key.description: True when a manual OpenCSG API key is saved or a built-in API key is available for the authenticated user.

api_key_prefix.description: Redacted API key prefix for display only.

api_key_error.description: Error returned while resolving the built-in API key, if any.

app_id.description: AI App identifier. Currently only codex-app supports manual paths.

path.description: Absolute path to the installed app (Windows .exe or macOS .app bundle).

source.description: Model source such as local, cloud, or provider:<id>.

provider_mode.description: Provider mode requested for apps that support explicit source switching.

model_bindings.description: Task-specific model selections used by multi-model apps such as Xiaozhi.

work_dir.description: Working directory used for shell-based AI App launches.

model_source.description: Persisted model source such as local, cloud, or provider:<id>.

provider_group.description: Shared provider state group. Codex CLI and Codex App both use codex.

provider_drifted.description: Whether the live app configuration changed after OpenCSG was enabled.

runtime_supported.description: Whether this app exposes a long-running runtime that can be started or stopped.

runtime_running.description: Whether the app runtime is currently reachable.

source.description: Model source such as local, cloud, or provider:<id>.

MarketplaceModelProviderMetadata.description: Source-native display metadata. Only the object matching artifact_source is populated.

repo_size.description: Total repository download size in bytes, including LFS objects.
Total repository download size in bytes, including LFS objects when the provider exposes file metadata.

file_count.description: Number of downloadable files when supplied by the provider.

repo_size.description: Total bytes reported by the paginated repository tree.

timed_out.description: True when metric collection exceeded its short server-side deadline.

full_name.description: Full local model repository ID when the marketplace model is downloaded.

public_id.description: Public local inference model ID when the marketplace model is downloaded.

upgrade_packages.description: Upgrade Diffuser-related Python packages instead of only installing missing runtime dependencies.

image.description: Internal field used by /api/images/jobs for base64 input images. Use POST /v1/images/edits for OpenAI-compatible image editing.

images.description: Internal field used by /api/images/jobs for additional base64 input images.

image.description: Input image file. Repeat the field to provide multiple images.

mask.description: Optional mask image with alpha channel for inpainting.

size.description: Output size in WIDTHxHEIGHT format when supported by the model.

source.description: Optional csghub-lite routing hint. Use cloud to call a configured cloud provider.

ImageGenerationJobListResponse.description: Image generation jobs. List responses use lightweight thumbnail image data in completed job results to keep history loading fast.

result.description: Image result data. In list responses this may contain thumbnail-sized image data; job detail and result endpoints return full-quality image data.

source.description: Model source such as local, cloud, or provider:<id>.

num_ctx.description: csghub-lite local runtime override for llama-server context length.

n_gpu_layers.description: csghub-lite local runtime override for llama-server GPU offload.

dtype.description: csghub-lite local SafeTensors to GGUF conversion dtype.

source.description: Model source such as local, cloud, or provider:<id>.

chat_template_kwargs.description: llama.cpp chat template variables, such as {"enable_thinking": false} for Qwen thinking models.

stream_options.description: OpenAI-compatible streaming options. Proxied streaming requests default include_usage to true so token usage can be observed.

stream.description: Whether to stream SSE chunks. When omitted, the server startup configuration controls the default; the standard default is false.

source.description: Optional source hint. Provider-scoped routes supply this value authoritatively.

upgrade_packages.description: Upgrade ASR Python packages while installing.

source.description: Set to cloud to proxy transcription to the configured AI Gateway.

hotwords.description: Comma-separated or JSON array hotwords for FunASR models.

itn.description: Enable inverse text normalization for supported ASR models.

stream.description: Stream transcription chunks as server-sent events while long audio is processed.
